Class RUtil

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.rbridge.RUtil
public final class RUtil extends Object
The API of the embedded R of Bio7 (the FFM bridge) for Java, Groovy and BeanShell scripts, as PythonUtil for Python. Plain Java types: the variables are created in the global environment of R (visible in the console and the R-Shell). 
RUtil.toR("x", 1.0, 2.0, 3.0);                     // numeric vector
RUtil.toR("m", new double[][] { { 1, 2 }, { 3, 4 } }); // matrix
Map<String, Object> cols = new LinkedHashMap<>();
cols.put("id", new int[] { 1, 2 });
cols.put("name", new String[] { "a", "b" });
RUtil.dataFrameToR("df", cols);                    // data frame
RUtil.exec("fit <- lm(dist ~ speed, cars)");
double[] coef = RUtil.fromRDoubles("coef(fit)");   // R -> Java
String text = RUtil.print("summary(fit)");          // the printed output
